items.item_text: Security guard state license (BSIS) and safety training certificate (Preferred)
Certification in First Aid, CPR and AED (Preferred)

Must have proficient computer skills and experience in and/or ability to learn the operation and applications related to electronic security systems, particularly the Software House, C-cure 9000 Alarm, CCTV, and dedicated camera platforms.

The Security Guard is responsible for protecting Library property, employees, and patrons, maintaining order among the public, patrolling and monitoring activities, discouraging misbehavior and criminal activity, ensuring the environment is safe and secure, and writing emails and detailed reports. This position understands and conveys policies and procedures for patrons and resolves problems. In addition, the Security Guard assists with training and monitoring the activities of student library employees (SLEs).
Commitment to providing excellent public service while maintaining library safety, security, and a welcoming research environment.
Demonstrate efficiency in multitasking, teamwork, and independent work, while exhibiting proactive behavior in completing assigned projects.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills to interact professionally and tactfully with colleagues, library staff, patrons, and visitors who may be a disruption in the library.
